parsedVerdict.reasoning: OrderService mostly does application-layer work. The problem is listOrders, which takes an Express `Request` as a parameter. An HTTP framework type in a use-case signature ties the application service to the transport, and transport belongs to the infrastructure/presentation layer. The parameter is never used, so no transport logic actually runs here, which lowers confidence. Still, the API surface carries a transport concern that does not belong to the application layer. The input checks and the all-or-nothing reservation in placeOrder are acceptable use-case orchestration.
